text:
Eleanor: Thanks for joining today's all-hands — recording + slides here: https://drive.redwood.ai/all-hands/jun-2024. Dropping quick follow-ups and owners so nothing falls through cracks.

Jae: Quick clarify on Dedicated autoscale: will per-model weights be supported at launch? @Eleanor

Eleanor: Not at GA. Per-pool only initially; per-model weights targeted for Q3. We'll publish a roadmap note.

Ravi: Action: I'll draft autoscale default configs (latency vs cost) and post PR to docs by Wed. @Priya can you review?

Priya: Yep, will review. Please include a short FAQ on when to tune batching.

Liam: Finance note: committed discounts will be tiered; publishing a draft pricing matrix next Tue. Sales can use it as a skeleton.

Hana: Marketing request: one-pager comparing Hosted / Dedicated / Private for customer-facing material. Who owns?

Eleanor: Marketing + Product to co-own. Hana lead on visuals, Sofia on copy. Priya please link docs.

all-hands-bot: Recording uploaded: https://zoom.redwood.ai/rec/ghi789 — transcript will follow.

Jae: Infra appendix ask from support: are 8x A100 still the recommended baseline for Private?

Ravi: Baseline yes for medium throughput. High throughput customers should consider 32x with NVLink. We'll add an appendix to the Private guide.

Priya: Action: I'll add a Troubleshooting FAQ and the infra appendix link. Also will surface quantization examples (quality vs cost) — Jae can you grab numbers from eng-ml?

Jae: Sure, will coordinate with eng-ml and produce a short table.

Ravi: Blocker: need a test cluster to validate the migration tooling. @Eleanor can infra provision a small cluster this week?

Eleanor: Approved. Eng-infra to provision a 4-GPU cluster. Expect invite by EOD.

Liam: Legal wants a sample DPA for Dedicated customers — legal will draft; I'll coordinate distribution to sales.

Priya: Sales checklist would be helpful (SLA, data residency, SOC2 status). I'll add to the docs and link the one-pager.

Eleanor: Summary of action owners: Ravi (autoscale defaults + test run), Jae (SLOs + quant table), Priya (docs + checklist), Hana (one-pager visuals), Liam (pricing + legal). Please update the shared follow-ups sheet: https://sheets.redwood.ai/d/1Z-followups by EOD Fri and mark blockers.

Hana: Scheduling a 30min design review Thurs 11am to review one-pager drafts.

Ravi: Example command demoed for canary rollout:
```
rw rollout create --pool dedicated --model redwood-medium-v2 --percent 10
```

Eleanor: Thanks all. I'll send an email summary and update the roadmap doc. If there are further Qs, add them to the sheet or DM me. Closing thread for Q&A.
